TextView.android:text: Find answers to common questions and learn how to use ExpenseVault to manage your expenses, income, budgets and subscriptions.
Browse the topics below for guidance on using the main ExpenseVault features.
After signing in, you can manage your income, expenses, budgets and subscriptions from ExpenseVault. Use the main navigation to move between the application sections.
Use the Expenses section to view and manage expense records. Expense information may include the amount, category, date, payment method and notes.
Use the Income section to record and review money received. Keeping income information accurate helps ExpenseVault provide more useful financial summaries and analysis.
Set your budget according to your financial plan. Review your spending against your budget regularly to identify when expenses are approaching or exceeding your planned limit.

Use Subscription Management to keep track of recurring services and their costs. Subscription information can support analysis of recurring spending and help identify potentially unused or wasteful subscriptions.
Family features allow supported financial information to be shared within a family group. Family membership and roles determine which information and actions are available to members.

The AI Financial Advisor uses available financial information to provide explanations, observations and recommendations. AI-generated guidance should be reviewed before making important financial decisions.

Notification preferences can be managed from Profile Settings. If notifications are not appearing, check the relevant preference and make sure notifications are allowed for ExpenseVault on your device.

If something is not working correctly, check your internet connection, make sure you are signed in, restart the application and try again. If the problem continues, record the error message and the steps that caused the problem before contacting support.
If you cannot find the answer you need, contact the ExpenseVault support team.
